question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.3.
solution:
The correct answer is: **'record'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in the blank is: **'record'.**
 
• The particular portion of the sentence needs a** 'Verb'.**
 
• So, **'****record' **is appropriate here.

Hence, the correct answer is: **'Option 2'.**

**Correct sentence**__: The left handed pages (1) __are written__ for the student to use individually, but they may of course be used by the (2) __teacher__ as a source of ideas and information on which to base a lesson. The student then has the left-hand page as a/an (3) __**record**__ of what has been taught and can refer to it in the (4)_______. The exercises can be done (5)_______, in class or as homework. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **'anecdote'** is not correct here.
 
• **'allusion'** is not correct here.
 
• **'illustration'** is not correct here.
